mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, it is a clear 27 degrees at Harriet Park with a Full Moon overhead, and we expect an overnight low of 25 degrees with no rain in the forecast.
Property tax bills are being mailed by December 15, and you can pay them in two installments or via drop box at City Center before the January 31 deadline.
There is plenty to do with trivia tomorrow at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's today and craft beer celebrations at Wisconsin Brewing Company this Thursday.
In a report from November 2, officers were dispatched to West End Circle where they arrested a man for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor was Butter Pecan, but since we are closed for the night, look forward to tomorrow's flavor, OREO REESE'S Cheesecake, when the store opens at 10 AM.
